channel.description: Latest articles from The Mary Sue (themarysue.com)

item.title: You Can Mourn Dilbert But Let's Not Forget Who Scott Adams Was
item.description: Scott Adams, the creator of Dilbert and controversial online figure, has passed away at the age of 68 today.

item.title: Michigan man worked at Ruby Tuesday for 19 years. Then he was fired after a shift on Christmas day: ‘I never missed a day of work’
item.description: Ruby Tuesday faces backlash after firing a Michigan general manager following 19 years following one difficult Christmas shift.

item.title: The 10 Best Horror Movies of the 21st Century
Can you get married on a plane? Southwest Airlines customers get a mid-flight surprise
item.description: Why invite guests to your wedding when you can force everyone on a Southwest flight to be your guests mid flight?

item.title: Woman’s Dior wedding dress arrives from Paris. Then she opens the box: ‘I don’t want to imagine the shipping cost’
item.description: In a now-viral TikTok, a bride and her two friends unbox a six-foot mannequin carrying her Dior gown from Paris.

item.title: Orange County woman says her hairstylist of 6 years fired her with no context. Now people are roasting her: ‘I don’t even know you and I know why’
item.description: An Orange County woman says her hairstylist of six years abruptly cut ties. But many commenters are saying it's her fault.

item.title: Server asks large table what they are celebrating. She wasn’t ready for their response. Now she’s issuing a warning to other servers
item.description: In a viral clip, a server warns other restaurant industry workers not to ask large parties what they are celebrating after it backfires.

item.title: Is the '9-1-1' Universe Connected to This Underrated Ryan Murphy Comedy?
item.description: A recent '9-1-1' Easter egg looked awfully familiar to 'Scream Queens' fans... and raises the question of whether or not they're in the same universe.

item.title: ‘Petco what the actual hell?’: Woman goes to the fish aisle at Petco. Then she sees something disturbing happened to one of the fish
item.description: A Petco shopper films a fish stuck outside its tank, prompting backlash and a public response from the retailer as viewers raise concerns.

item.title: The Wait for HBO's Controversial Teen Drama's Season 3 Is Almost Over
item.description: 'Euphoria' is finally coming back after all this time and fans are excited to see where Rue and all her friends are now.
